synthetic_policy.reverse_routes: Demo reverses this observed network for round trips; reverse availability is synthetic and is not separately verified for a date.
synthetic_policy.pricing: One seat per adult/child; all ages use the same synthetic fare. Pets 1500 RUB each, baggage 2000 RUB per person separately. Month, date, variant and seed affect synthetic prices. No real fares or timetable are copied from source pages.
